property.name: mapreduce.input.fileinputformat.split.minsize
property.description: 1 GiB. Split size = max(minsize, min(maxsize, blocksize)), so a minimum larger than any document gives exactly ONE split (= one map task) per document. The mapper numbers rows by counting lines from the top of its split, so a split must always start at the beginning of a file.

property.name: mapreduce.input.fileinputformat.input.dir.recursive
property.description: Also read documents in sub-folders of the input directory (the corpus zip may unpack into folders).

property.name: stream.num.map.output.key.fields
property.description: Key = the first tab-separated field of a mapper line (the document name). The rest ("row:col") is the value.

property.name: mapreduce.job.reduces
property.description: One reducer produces a single, sorted result file (part-00000). Output is tiny, so there is no benefit from more.

property.name: mapreduce.map.memory.mb
property.description: Container size per map task: JVM + the Rscript process.

property.name: mapreduce.map.java.opts
property.description: JVM heap kept below the container limit, leaving room for R.

property.name: mapreduce.map.maxattempts
property.description: A failed map task is re-run (on another node if needed). Safe because the mapper is idempotent: same split in, same pairs out.
